top_tweets.text:
We chose TOML for Cargo because:

1. JSON has no comments
2. XML sucks to write by hand
3. INI is not specified at all
4. YAML trauma from using it too much in Ruby

TOML isn’t perfect but it’s overall a really nice spot in the design space
top_tweets.author: steveklabnik
top_tweets.name: Steve Klabnik
top_tweets.summary_zh: Cargo 選擇 TOML 作為配置格式的原因：JSON 無註解、XML 手寫困難、INI 缺乏規範、YAML 在 Ruby 生態中的負面經驗，TOML 在設計空間中是相對理想的平衡點。
